ReleaseNotes: Six-month expiry warnings include expired stock and consistent supplier exports. Dashboard and daily report share corrected sales and profit calculations; new sales snapshot stock cost. Medicine packaging fields start empty, labels explain packets and tablets, and stock is added through Purchase. Box purchase costs convert correctly to per-tablet cost. Billing shows percentage and PKR discount inputs on one row, with one active method and no automatic cross-filling. Extra is removed from new billing; historical bills retain saved charges. Ctrl+S saves, Ctrl+P saves and prints, Enter checkout still works, and the save button is named Save. Shop database configuration is preserved.
